prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Katy, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1103; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on tape, if that's okay. You can use the claim number.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in a parking lot at a shopping center in Katy, Texas. I was backing out of a space near the main entrance.
Q: What time of day was it, and what were the weather and lighting conditions?
A: It was in the afternoon. It was sunny and dry, and the lot was pretty busy.
Q: Walk me through what happened as you were backing out.
A: I checked my mirrors and didn't see anything behind me. I started rolling back slowly, and then I felt an impact on the rear passenger side. The other car was coming down the aisle, and I think they were going a bit fast for a parking lot.
Q: Did you or the other driver stop before the impact?
A: I stopped right away once I felt the bump. I don't think the other driver braked until the last second.
Q: Were you injured at the scene?
A: Not obviously. I felt stiff in my neck and my lower back started aching within an hour or so. By the next morning it was worse.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care the following day and was told I had neck and back strain. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week since then.
Q: Are you currently taking any medication or missing work?
A: I'm taking over-the-counter pain relievers. I've missed a few shifts because sitting and lifting are hard right now.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the collision?
A: Only that I'm not trying to make more of this than it was. I just want my bills covered and to get back to normal.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
